title: Type of treatment-limiting toxicity ValueSet Schema
description: JSON Schema for Type of treatment-limiting toxicity ValueSet ValueSet codes. Generated from FHIR expansions using IRI format.
narrative: This schema validates IRI-formatted codes for the Type of treatment-limiting toxicity ValueSet ValueSet.
